name: normal-pet-visual-models
description: Verify all five non-Robux pets use their selected visual-only child from Creator Store pack 70715599928632 with exact identity, bounded size, item-matched styling, and zero behavior descendants.

args.code: local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation c:Invoke('Reset') return c:Invoke('GrantPet',{name='Forest Pup',stars=1}).ok and 'PUP_GRANTED' or 'PUP_FAILED'

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local f=workspace:FindFirstChild(p.Name..' Client Companions') local m=f and f:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('Model') local unsafe=0 if m then for _,d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA('LuaSourceContainer') or d:IsA('Sound') or d:IsA('Tool') or d:IsA('RemoteEvent') or d:IsA('RemoteFunction') or d:IsA('ClickDetector') or d:IsA('ProximityPrompt') then unsafe+=1 end end end local valid=m and m:GetAttribute('PetDefinitionName')=='Forest Pup' and m:GetAttribute('VisualSource')=='ExternalTemplate' and m:GetAttribute('PetVisualIdentity')=='Sanitized_ForestPupPet' and m:GetAttribute('SourcePackModelName')=='Dowodle' and tostring(m:GetAttribute('CreatorStorePackAssetId'))=='70715599928632' and m:GetAttribute('CatalogPetStyleVersion')=='CreatorStorePackMatchedV2' and unsafe==0 return H:JSONEncode({valid=valid==true,name=m and m:GetAttribute('PetDefinitionName'),source=m and m:GetAttribute('VisualSource'),identity=m and m:GetAttribute('PetVisualIdentity'),packModel=m and m:GetAttribute('SourcePackModelName'),pack=tostring(m and m:GetAttribute('CreatorStorePackAssetId')),unsafe=unsafe})

steps.label: Forest Pup uses sanitized Dowodle pack child

args.code: local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation c:Invoke('Reset') return c:Invoke('GrantPet',{name='Miner Cat',stars=1}).ok and 'MINER_GRANTED' or 'MINER_FAILED'

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local f=workspace:FindFirstChild(p.Name..' Client Companions') local m=f and f:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('Model') local s=nil if m then local ignored,size=m:GetBoundingBox(); s=size end local largest=s and math.max(s.X,s.Y,s.Z) or 99 local valid=m and m:GetAttribute('PetDefinitionName')=='Miner Cat' and m:GetAttribute('VisualSource')=='ExternalTemplate' and m:GetAttribute('PetVisualIdentity')=='Sanitized_MinerCatPet' and m:GetAttribute('SourcePackModelName')=='Catmouse' and tostring(m:GetAttribute('CreatorStorePackAssetId'))=='70715599928632' and m:GetAttribute('CatalogPetThemeMatched')==true and m:GetAttribute('CatalogPetColorMatched')==true and largest>=.65 and largest<=1.66 return H:JSONEncode({valid=valid==true,name=m and m:GetAttribute('PetDefinitionName'),source=m and m:GetAttribute('VisualSource'),identity=m and m:GetAttribute('PetVisualIdentity'),packModel=m and m:GetAttribute('SourcePackModelName'),matched=m and m:GetAttribute('CatalogPetThemeMatched'),largest=largest})

steps.label: Miner Cat uses sanitized item-matched external visual
